title: Optimizing Solar Tracking Algorithms
excerpt: A deep dive into dual-axis solar tracking algorithms. How to maximize energy yield using astronomical equations.
content:
## The Need for Tracking

Fixed solar panels miss out on a significant amount of potential energy. By tracking the sun's trajectory, we can increase yield by up to 40%.

## Astronomical Algorithms

Instead of relying purely on LDR sensors, modern trackers use astronomical equations to calculate the sun's exact position (azimuth and elevation) based on time and GPS coordinates.

### Benefits
- Immune to cloud cover interference
- Higher precision
- Predictive positioning

## Implementation

Using an ESP32, we can easily pull time from an NTP server, calculate the position, and adjust the servo motors accordingly.

## Conclusion

Hybrid systems that combine astronomical calculations with sensor feedback offer the best performance and reliability.
